artifacts.description: Preregistered CLASS_SPEC for VOLPROF-M1 (volume-profile class on EURUSD/GBPUSD/USDJPY M1 Dukascopy panels, Pool B), revision r1 2026-09-29 after Lane D's physical audit + remediation r2 2026-09-29 (skeptic F-9 MEDIUM). 3 frozen arm shapes x 3 pairs = 9 CLASS_CANDIDATEs (VC1-VAEDGE, VC2-LVNFAIL, VC3-POCMAG); payer = resting liquidity / recurring execution flow at accepted levels (stop-cluster fuel secondary); observable = M1 volume column declared per Lane D audit as SIZE-WEIGHTED per-tick volume sum in Dukascopy units, unit-basis UNVERIFIABLE — NOT a tick count (only 2.49/3.50/3.71% of active minutes integral); correction stated as CLOSER to a true volume profile (per-tick size present, strengthens level-acceptance claim) with hard limits: no absolute notional semantics, no cross-pair volume comparability, no count semantics, unit opacity, volatility/session contamination guarded by CTRL-D; section 3.3 verifies ALL constructions unit-invariant (argmax/percentile/ratio only — zero parameter changes); BID-side volume column frozen (ASK declared unused); frozen profile construction (20-trading-day lookback, W=0.25xATR20d on 0.1-pip grid, POC=max-activity bin, VA>=70%, LVN=P20 holes); clock = weekly Friday 20:00 UTC freeze + tzdata-rebuilt London/NY sessions, staleness fail-closed 90s, next-bar-open quoted-side fills; costs per COST_AUTHORITY_TABLE (C1 fill-hour cells reproduced EXACTLY by Lane D; U2/U3 DECLARED; U4/U5 structurally zero by flat-by-19:55-UTC; C2 Mon-Thu wrong-hour flag recorded as cross-lane action item, immaterial to this class); R2: CTRL-B redefined as TWO-ARM placebo family — B1 day-blocked within-day permutation RETAINED as decomposition diagnostic (survives-by-construction stated exactly: price path, per-day volume multisets/totals, cross-day volume-price-range association; intraday seasonality destroyed), B2 FULL-WINDOW minute permutation GOVERNS THE KILL (survives exactly the volume magnitude multiset + price path; expected placebo profile = rescaled time-at-price histogram = CTRL-D up to scale; therefore independent of the real volume-price-level assignment and unable to produce an acceptance POC); Q-11 movement diagnostic keyed to B2; B1 outcomes produce informative labels (POC_CROSSDAY_DRIVEN, EDGE_CROSSDAY_COMPONENT_ONLY), not kills; section 8 ancestry = INFORMATIVE NOT GATING per owner amendment 2026-09-29 (representation-rho protocol, verbatim death records + fence texts for DT100-13-VWAPMR and 16 neighbors, rho>0.20 = RHO_TWIN_OF redundancy label); falsification keeps cost/floor/control kills (20/3/100, COST_DOMINATED at x1.5); section 10 audit checklist RESOLVED (12,552 files clean, DATA_FREEZE overall sha256 d8d9807f...; remaining external: engine tzdata pin, program-wide C2 correction); COMPLEMENTARITY NOTES; self-assessment: implementable audit-resolved, worth diagnostic runs, expected outcome NEGATIVE under program prior, VC3-POCMAG designated likeliest casualty. All content HYPOTHESIS/NOT_RUN; no backtest implied anywhere.

outputs.spec_revision: r1 (2026-09-29): section 3 rewritten on Lane D volume-semantics finding; section 3.3 added (unit-invariance); section 10 rewritten (audit RESOLVED); status CONDITIONAL_PENDING_DATA_AUDIT -> CONDITIONAL_RESOLVED_AUDIT_CLEAN; sections 1/2/6/7/8.1/8.2/12 updated for consistent observable naming; BID-side volume freeze added to 3.2. r2 (2026-09-29, remediation of skeptic F-9 MEDIUM): CTRL-B redefined as two-arm placebo family in section 7b (B1 day-blocked decomposition diagnostic + B2 full-window permutation governing the kill); cross-references updated in header, 1.1 falsifier cells, 3.3 table, 5.1-5.3 falsifiers, 7 intro, 9 item 3, 9.6 interpretation, 12

remediation_r2.finding: Skeptic F-9 MEDIUM: the r0/r1 day-blocked volume shuffle preserves the cross-day volume<->price-range association (each day's total volume stays inside that day's price range), so the placebo was weaker than its 'destroys the level-acceptance structure' claim — a stronger-than-warranted null-validity claim
remediation_r2.fix: CTRL-B redefined as a two-arm placebo family; the STRONGER arm (B2 full-window minute permutation) governs the kill; B1 retained as a decomposition diagnostic with survives-by-construction stated exactly; Q-11 movement diagnostic re-keyed to B2; B1 outcomes produce labels (POC_CROSSDAY_DRIVEN, EDGE_CROSSDAY_COMPONENT_ONLY), not kills
remediation_r2.ctrl_b1: day-blocked within-day minute permutation (r0/r1 construction): survives price path, per-day volume multisets/totals, and the cross-day volume<->price-range association; destroys intraday seasonality; tests ONLY within-day volume-level covariation — not a valid null for the full level-acceptance claim on its own
remediation_r2.ctrl_b2: full-window minute permutation (one global permutation across all tradable minutes of the 20-day lookback): survives exactly the volume magnitude multiset + the price path; the placebo profile's sampling distribution is independent of the real volume<->price-level assignment; expectation = (total volume / N minutes) x time-at-price = rescaled CTRL-D profile, deviations are exchangeable assignment noise — the surviving structure cannot produce an acceptance POC, only the time-at-price mode plus noise

observable_declaration_r1.evidence: Lane D DATA_AUDIT_REPORT section C: 2.49/3.50/3.71% (EURUSD/GBPUSD/USDJPY) integral active minutes; float32 encodings 0.09-2985; 86-97% of positive values multiples of 0.01 at small sizes; weekday active 92.05-92.33%; core/lull 1.97-3.17x; corr with per-minute range 0.52-0.67; BID/ASK vol corr 0.72-0.91, ASK/BID total 0.93-0.96, tradable masks identical
observable_declaration_r1.unit_basis: NOT_RUN — unverifiable from candles (needs instrument metadata or tick files)
observable_declaration_r1.direction_of_correction: CLOSER to a true volume profile than the originally-declared tick-count proxy: per-tick size information present, level acceptance measured in size-weighted activity — STRENGTHENS the level-acceptance claim, subject to the unit caveat
observable_declaration_r1.unit_invariance: verified clause-by-clause in spec section 3.3: tradable mask (sign), POC (argmax), VA-70% (ratio), LVN-P20 / VC1-P20 / VC3-P80 (percentiles), CTRL-B shuffle (permutation), CTRL-D uniform (unit-free) — all invariant under positive affine rescaling; zero parameter changes from r1
observable_declaration_r1.side_freeze: BID-side volume column used; ASK column declared and not used (two measures of same flow, corr 0.72-0.91)

outputs.amendment_applied: Owner amendment 2026-09-29 (relayed by A1): ancestry is a label, not a gate. Section 8 written as informative measured-and-disclosed representation-rho protocol; section 9 rho kill demoted to RHO_TWIN_OF redundancy label; causal controls and cost/floor kills remain gating; closing self-assessment addresses implementability + diagnostic value; COMPLEMENTARITY NOTES section added.

key_decisions: Arm set frozen at exactly the campaign cap: 3 shapes x 3 pairs = 9 CLASS_CANDIDATEs; the plan's 54-node TRAIN-only parameter grid budget is NOT invoked — every parameter is a single frozen named value (no tuning surface).

All three arms are fade-side (mean-reverting, intraday, flat by 19:55 UTC): funded by the named payer (resting liquidity / recurring execution flow at accepted levels); the join/acceptance-break side is deliberately NOT preregistered (weakest diagnostic candidate; own-price continuation shape).
Stop-cluster fuel declared SECONDARY payer only — the stop-flow payer family belongs to the fenced range-fade class and this class does not rest admission on it.

R1 (Lane D correction): observable RENAMED from 'tick-volume' to size-weighted volume (Dukascopy unit, unit-basis unverifiable); the correction stated as strengthening the level-acceptance claim (per-tick size present) with tightened limits (no notional semantics, no cross-pair raw-volume comparability, no count semantics, unit opacity).

R1: unit-invariance verified clause-by-clause (new section 3.3) — POC/VA/LVN/P20/P80/tradable-mask/placebo/uniform constructions are all ratio/ordinal/sign-based, invariant under positive affine rescaling; the semantics correction changes ZERO frozen parameters and ZERO trigger definitions.
R1: BID-side volume column frozen for the profile (ASK column a second measure of the same flow, corr 0.72-0.91 — one side must be frozen; choice deterministic, recorded in arm_config_digest).

R1: spec status moved CONDITIONAL_PENDING_DATA_AUDIT -> CONDITIONAL_RESOLVED_AUDIT_CLEAN (panels clean: 12,552 files, 0 missing/0 undecodable, coverage 2021-01-01..2026-09-23; C1 fill cells reproduced exactly); remaining external items (engine tzdata pin; program-wide C2 Mon-Thu correction) recorded as non-blocking.

Profile frozen WEEKLY at the Friday 20:00 UTC master stamp (not daily) — minimizes estimation choices, keeps one master clock, PIT-clean; intraday triggers consume only the frozen profile + live M1; fake-LVN risk from zero-volume runs excluded by the tradable-mask-before-binning rule.

Session clock rebuilt from pinned IANA tzdata (Europe/London 08:00-12:00, America/New_York 09:30-16:00) — no hardcoded DST; holiday authority = the panels themselves (zero-tradable-minutes sessions skipped); Lane D confirmed panel stamps are UTC and shift with US DST as expected.

Swap independence by construction (no position crosses the 22:00 UTC accrual boundary): class is neither swap-receiving (BLOCKED_COST) nor swap-paying; any amendment allowing overnight holds must re-clear costs.

Four gating control ids preregistered: dwell-matched random entry; clock-only shadow (Q-7); uniform-weight time-at-price profile (post-r1 sharpened: separates size-weighted acceptance from pure time-at-price — exactly the increment the corrected observable claims to carry); and the volume-placebo CTRL-B, redefined in r2 as a TWO-ARM family (B1 day-blocked decomposition diagnostic + B2 full-window permutation governing the kill) per skeptic F-9.

R2 (F-9 remediation): the r0/r1 day-blocked shuffle was acknowledged as preserving the cross-day volume<->price-range association — weaker than its 'destroys the level-acceptance structure' claim; the fix keeps B1 as a diagnostic with survives-by-construction stated exactly, and adds B2 (full-window minute permutation) as the kill-governing arm whose placebo profile distribution is provably independent of the real volume<->price-level assignment (expectation = rescaled time-at-price histogram; deviations = exchangeable assignment noise; cannot produce an acceptance POC). B1-only outcomes are labels, not kills (POC_CROSSDAY_DRIVEN; EDGE_CROSSDAY_COMPONENT_ONLY) — a profile edge carried by the day-level component is still volume-by-price information and is no longer falsely killable by the weaker null.

Section 8 per amendment: verbatim death records and fence texts preserved as history; representation-rho protocol defined (reconstruction specs for 9 neighbors incl. exact DT100 engine parameters; indicator + continuous rho; 0.20 remains the reference bar for the RHO_TWIN_OF redundancy label, not a gate); the M-3 'declare the tick-count volume proxy' duty discharged WITH the correction that the assumed semantics were wrong (incident I-3).

The three Pool-B corpus rows (EURUSD-S010, USDJPY-S030, USDJPY-S056) are NOT preregistered as-is (each fails implementability as-written: unevidenced PIT calendars / transport-blocked CME volume / intervention labels); the class enters as fresh CLASS_CANDIDATEs, consistent with campaign design 'no anonymous arms'.

Honest self-assessment (r1): implementable, audit-resolved clean; worth diagnostic runs (only unclaimed observable surface on the M1 pairs, strengthened by the size-weighting correction; cheap decisive controls); expected outcome NEGATIVE under the program's own prior; VC3-POCMAG designated likeliest casualty (price-only anchor substitute risk; survival depends on CTRL-B/CTRL-D doing the work the amendment no longer asks ancestry to do).
known_limitations: No backtest, no rho measurement, no PnL, no scoring was run — the spec's feasibility counts, control outcomes and cost outcomes are all preregistered expectations, not measurements; every idea remains HYPOTHESIS/NOT_RUN.

The payer is a hypothesis with no direct observation (no order book, no flow tape); the spec's own citation chain (COMMNG1-A4-P2) shows even observed positioning lost to its clock shadow, so the payer story stands or falls with the CTRL-C/CTRL-B controls.

The absolute Dukascopy volume unit is NOT_RUN (unverifiable from the candles; would need instrument metadata or tick files): all volume claims are strictly within-pair and relative; cross-pair raw-volume pooling is forbidden by the spec.

The >=95% entry-window tradable-minute availability requirement is retained as a Stage-A admission check: Lane D measured 92.05-92.33% weekday-wide activity (peak in London/NY), but the exact entry-window fraction was not separately reported and is Stage-A arithmetic, not asserted.

Reconstruction-based rho for crypto-native neighbors (A6-V16-F1, SRLVX1, XSECT-VOLSHK, SFV4, M01) is skeleton-table labeling only — they cannot be reconstructed on FX M1 panels; disclosed as such in section 8.4.
Decision-count expectations per arm are order-of-magnitude reasoning, not measurements; the binding risk is over-filtering (VC3) producing NOT_RUN_THIN — by design that outcome is typed, not rescued.
The owner amendment 2026-09-29 is known to this lane only as relayed by A1 mid-session; if the owner's written amendment differs, section 8/9 gating language is the part to re-check.
The engine-side tzdata pin is still open (not Lane D's scope); it is the only remaining freeze action before the Stage-A admission battery.
incidents: I-1 MEDIUM (data-label defect, verdict-neutral): FAMILY_FAILURES.jsonl DT100 rows carry asset:'crypto' uniformly, but the DT100 engine config (.worktrees/daytrader-100-v1/integration/research/daytrader100/dt100/arms.py, FX section) ran DT100-13-VWAPMR, DT100-15-BOLLFADE, DT100-07-PDHLSWEEPFX, DT100-09-ASIANRANGE, DT100-10-LONDONMOM on EURUSD 1m and DT100-31-JPYFADE on USDJPY 1m. The dead VWAPMR neighbor is same-pair same-bar-size as this class's EURUSD panel — closer than F0 salvage note 1 implied. Recommend a ledger erratum when a writable lane owns it.

I-2 LOW (naming defect, verdict-neutral): the dead neighbor's 'VWAP' anchor is a close-only running mean (signals.py vwap_mr: tp=df['c'], groupby-day cumsum/count) — volume-blind; the skeptic's M-3 note called it a 'volume-weighted-anchor neighbor'. The correction cuts both ways: the neighbor is skeleton-closer (deviation fade to anchor) but information-farther (never read any volume field).

I-3 MEDIUM->RESOLVED-BY-REVISION (observable-semantics defect in this spec's r0, corrected r1 2026-09-29): the spec originally declared the M1 volume column a 'tick count per minute' proxy per the dispatch premise; Lane D's physical audit REFUTED that premise (only 2.5-3.7% of active minutes integral; float32 size-weighted sum in unverifiable Dukascopy units). Section 3 rewritten: observable renamed size-weighted volume, cannot-claim limits rewritten (no notional semantics / no cross-pair comparability / no count semantics / unit opacity), direction of correction stated honestly (closer to a true volume profile — per-tick size present — strengthening the level-acceptance claim subject to the unit caveat), unit-invariance of all constructions verified in new section 3.3 (zero parameter changes), BID-side volume frozen, section 10 checklist marked RESOLVED, status CONDITIONAL_RESOLVED_AUDIT_CLEAN. The dispatch text, the F0 authorities note ('volume column present') and the skeptic M-3 note all carried the tick-count assumption; no prior artifact in this program had measured the field's semantics before Lane D.

I-4 MEDIUM->RESOLVED-BY-REMEDIATION (null-validity defect in this spec's r0/r1 CTRL-B, corrected r2 2026-09-29 per skeptic finding F-9): the day-blocked within-day volume shuffle preserves the cross-day volume<->price-range association (each day's TOTAL volume remains inside that day's price range), so the r0/r1 claim that the placebo 'destroys the level-acceptance structure' was stronger than warranted — a genuine profile edge carried by the day-level component would have survived B1's construction and been falsely killable, and conversely B1's failure to degrade the arm proved less than the section claimed. Remediation r2: CTRL-B redefined as a two-arm family (B1 day-blocked diagnostic with survives-by-construction stated exactly; B2 full-window permutation governing the kill, provably independent of the volume<->price-level assignment); Q-11 movement diagnostic re-keyed to B2; B1 outcomes become informative labels (POC_CROSSDAY_DRIVEN, EDGE_CROSSDAY_COMPONENT_ONLY), not kills; sections 7b, 9.3 and cross-references updated.
